title: Create a matching 4-digit PIN
description: A user can set and confirm a four-digit PIN and complete PIN setup.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the vault access flow
Switch to the create account view
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the form
Enter a 4-digit PIN
Re-enter the same 4-digit PIN
Complete PIN setup
Verify the unlock success animation is visible

title: Sign in to an existing vault account

Open the vault access flow

Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the form
Verify the vault is displayed

title: Unlock a locked item and view decrypted details
description: Verifies that a signed-in user can unlock a protected vault item with a PIN and view the decrypted details.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Wait for the vault dashboard to load
Select a locked vault item
Enter the 4-digit security PIN
Submit the PIN
Verify the decrypted item details are displayed
Verify copy controls for the revealed data are visible

steps.description: Navigate to /

Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the form
Fill in the full name field with Test User
Fill in the optional phone field with a valid phone number
Upload an avatar photo from the local device
Continue to save the profile
Verify the next setup step is displayed

title: Lock out repeated failed PIN attempts
description: Verifies that a signed-in user is temporarily locked out after five incorrect PIN attempts on a locked item.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Wait for the vault dashboard to load
Select a locked vault item
Enter an incorrect 4-digit PIN
Submit the PIN
Repeat the incorrect PIN entry until the fifth failed attempt
Verify a temporary lockout message is visible
Verify unlocking is blocked during the lockout
